title: Vasco defeat Palmeiras 2-0 to win the U-20 Brazilian Championship
seoTitle: Vasco beat Palmeiras 2-0 to win U-20 Brasileirão
subtitle: Andrey Fernandes scored both goals to secure the victory in the final in São Paulo
excerpt: Andrey Fernandes scored both goals to give Vasco a 2-0 victory over Palmeiras in the U-20 Brazilian Championship final, securing their first.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Vasco secured their first U-20 Brazilian Championship title by defeating Palmeiras 2-0 in the decisive match in São Paulo. The scoreline ended up being the most searched topic on the internet after the final, as forward Andrey Fernandes scored both goals that decided the clash.

Andrey Fernandes decides the final

In the match, the number 7 forward was the key figure of the comeback. After losing 1-0 in the first leg, Vasco needed to win in São Paulo. Andrey scored twice, sealing the 2-0 victory that won the trophy for the club.

History of goals in decisive matches

Andrey's performance in the final reinforces a history of decisive goals in knockout stages. In the semifinal against Santos, Vasco overturned a 2-0 deficit to win 2-0, with two goals from Andrey, and advanced on penalties. This pattern of playing a leading role in critical moments was already a recurring theme in the youth academy.

2026 season

With the two goals in the final, Andrey ended the U-20 Brasileirão with 13 goals. He has accumulated 24 goals and three assists in 36 matches throughout 2026, making him Vasco's top scorer of the season. The forward had already stood out in 2024, scoring in the 3-0 victory over Flamengo in the U-16 Copa Rio final.

Previous achievements

In 2025, Andrey helped Vasco win the U-17 Copa do Brasil, scoring three goals in the semifinal against Flamengo and another in the final against Bahia, finishing the competition as top scorer. In the same year, the club won the U-20 Campeonato Carioca, with Andrey recording 19 goals and three assists in 40 matches.

Significance of the title

The U-20 Brasileirão title represents the first national achievement in this category for Vasco. The victory also highlights the importance of the youth academy in developing talents who can reinforce the first team in the coming years.
